title: The spec's checkpoint sentences omit that a checkpoint's observations and evidence enter the run feed
outcome: The spec's checkpoint sentences omit that a checkpoint's observations and evidence enter the run feed
acceptance: docs/spec.md §2.7 and §3.1 say that a turn checkpoint's control event goes only to the task's change index (an audit record no production path consumes), and that the same checkpoint's execution observations and evidence are canonical records appended to the run/root work feeds, which obligations and completion read

Where docs/spec.md and docs/features/behavioral-control-plane.md say a restart expires issued, unbegun grants, they name the mechanism: reopening the session's host-control connection, or lazily a status read or rebind

completion.summary:
Landed in 240e4c7 on master as one Markdown changeset with w-1ad48d5ce497, w-524b15d690c5 and w-787d1a13d22f.

Spec §2.7 and §3.1:
- A turn checkpoint's control event is stored as an object and indexed only in the task's change index, an audit record no production path consumes.
- Its execution observations and verification and environment evidence are canonical work records on the project, root and run feeds, read by obligations and completion while the run is unfinished.

Restart wording, in spec and bcp:
- Reopening the session's host-control connection expires issued, unbegun grants.
- A rebind does the same.
- A status read lazily expires overdue issued grants.
